---
title: "Expansion of the CD4_CXCL13 TIL clonotypes and differences between expanded and non-expanded cells"
author: "Endika Prieto <endikaprieto@vhio.net>"
date: "2026-11-13"
---

# setup

For each patient, takes the TCR clonotypes of the TIL cells that fall in one cluster of the TIL single-cell data
(`CD4_CXCL13`), classifies them by their behaviour in the deep TCR beta sequencing repertoires (frequency in PE,
the primary expansion, compared with Bulk) and then compares the cells of the two groups: differentially expressed
genes (DEG, RNA) and proteins (DEP, CITE-seq antibodies).

Classification of a clonotype (`classification <- "pe_vs_bulk"`):

- **Expanded**: frequency in PE higher than in Bulk (any increase).
- **Not expanded**: detected in Bulk, with a frequency in PE equal or lower.
- **Not detected in PE or Bulk**: productive clonotype of the TCRb-seq table of the patient, absent from both.
- **Not in TCRb-seq**: beta chain (CDR3 nucleotide sequence + TRBJ) absent from the TCRb-seq table of the patient.
- **Not classifiable**: the patient has no PE or no Bulk repertoire.

A classification stored in the metadata of the TIL object can be used instead (`classification <- "metadata"`
and `metadata_class_column`); the object in `til-data/` has no such column at the moment.

Outputs in `patients/cd4-cxcl13-expansion/`: clonotype list, summary per patient, DEG and DEP tables, and an
interactive HTML report.

The TIL object is large (2.4 GB on disk): run this on a compute node, not on the front end.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- Define paths ---
# R is started in renv-sturcotte/ (scripts/interactive-R.sh), so ".." is the project folder
project_dir <- normalizePath("..", mustWork = TRUE)
datapath <- file.path(project_dir, "patients")
til_file <- file.path(project_dir, "til-data", "cite1_2_3_4_5_6_8_withoutPat400304_TCR_ADT_virus_singlets.rds")
bulk_file <- file.path(datapath, "clonotypes_adaptive_bulk_productivefreqs_update.rds")   # same file as in petasan .../sturcotte/tcrb/
template_file <- file.path(project_dir, "scripts", "reports", "cxcl13-expansion-template.html")
output_dir <- file.path(datapath, "cd4-cxcl13-expansion")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# --- Parameters ---
cluster_column <- "clusters_old"
cluster_name <- "CD4_CXCL13"
classification <- "pe_vs_bulk"      # "pe_vs_bulk" or "metadata"
metadata_class_column <- NULL       # column of the TIL metadata with a clonotype class, for classification "metadata"
til_reduction <- "umap.cca"
patients_use <- NULL                # NULL = the patients of the UMAP viewer (those with a prioritization table); or e.g. c("CHUM_3513")
min_cells_patient <- 3              # cells per group needed for a patient to count in the per-patient direction check
min_cells_pooled <- 10              # cells per group needed to test all the patients together
min_cells_single <- 5               # cells per group needed to test one patient on its own
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
coord_quant <- 4095L
# --- Load libraries ---
library(Seurat)
library(jsonlite)
set.seed(123)
```

# load

```{r}
obj <- readRDS(til_file)
md <- obj[[]]
emb <- Embeddings(obj, reduction = til_reduction)[rownames(md), 1:2]
bulk <- readRDS(bulk_file)
# --- Keep the patients of the analysis ---
if (is.null(patients_use)) {
  tables <- list.files(datapath, pattern = "^prioritized_.*_tcrs_for_validation\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE)
  patients_use <- sort(unique(paste0("CHUM_", sub("^pt", "", sub("/.*$", "", tables)))))
}
stopifnot(length(patients_use) > 0, all(patients_use %in% md$patient_id))
obj <- subset(obj, cells = rownames(md)[md$patient_id %in% patients_use])
md <- obj[[]]
emb <- emb[rownames(md), , drop = FALSE]
cat("Patients:", paste(patients_use, collapse = ", "), "| TIL cells:", nrow(md), "\n")
stopifnot(all(c("patient_id", "subset_id", "clonotype", "cdr3_j", cluster_column) %in% colnames(md)),
          cluster_name %in% md[[cluster_column]])
in_cluster <- md[[cluster_column]] == cluster_name
cat(cluster_name, "cells:", sum(in_cluster), "| with a TCR:", sum(in_cluster & !is.na(md$cdr3_j)), "\n")
table(md$patient_id[in_cluster], with_TCR = !is.na(md$cdr3_j[in_cluster]))
```

# classify

One row per clonotype with at least one cell in the cluster, per patient. The TCRb-seq frequencies are those of
the productive clonotype with the same beta chain (CDR3 nucleotide sequence + TRBJ).

```{r}
class_levels <- c("Expanded", "Not expanded", "Not detected in PE or Bulk", "Not in TCRb-seq", "Not classifiable")
repertoires <- c(Tumor = "tumor", Blood = "blood", PE = "PE", Bulk = "bulk", TIDAL01 = "TIDAL01")
clonotypes <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(md$patient_id[in_cluster])), function(patient) {
  cells_patient <- md$patient_id == patient & !is.na(md$cdr3_j)
  cells <- cells_patient & in_cluster
  if (!any(cells)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  keys <- names(sort(table(md$cdr3_j[cells]), decreasing = TRUE))
  first <- match(keys, md$cdr3_j[cells])
  out <- data.frame(
    patient = patient,
    clonotype = md$clonotype[cells][first],
    cdr3_aa = md$tcr_cdr3_aa[cells][first],
    cdr3_j = keys,
    cells_in_cluster = as.integer(table(md$cdr3_j[cells])[keys]),
    cells_in_TILs = as.integer(table(md$cdr3_j[cells_patient])[keys]),
    cells_PD1p = as.integer(table(factor(md$cdr3_j[cells & md$subset_id == "PD1p"], levels = keys))),
    cells_PD1d = as.integer(table(factor(md$cdr3_j[cells & md$subset_id == "PD1d"], levels = keys)))
  )
  bulk_pt <- bulk[[patient]]
  has_repertoire <- function(x) !is.null(bulk_pt) && sum(bulk_pt[[x]][bulk_pt$productive == "yes"], na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  if (!is.null(bulk_pt)) {
    productive <- bulk_pt[bulk_pt$productive == "yes" & !duplicated(bulk_pt$cdr3_j), ]
    hit <- match(keys, productive$cdr3_j)
    for (name in names(repertoires)) {
      out[[paste0(name, "_freq")]] <- if (has_repertoire(repertoires[[name]])) productive[[repertoires[[name]]]][hit] else NA_real_
    }
    out$in_TCRb_seq <- !is.na(hit)
  } else {
    for (name in names(repertoires)) out[[paste0(name, "_freq")]] <- NA_real_
    out$in_TCRb_seq <- FALSE
  }
  out$class <- if (!has_repertoire("PE") || !has_repertoire("bulk")) {
    "Not classifiable"
  } else {
    ifelse(!out$in_TCRb_seq, "Not in TCRb-seq",
      ifelse(out$PE_freq > out$Bulk_freq, "Expanded",
        ifelse(out$Bulk_freq > 0, "Not expanded", "Not detected in PE or Bulk")))
  }
  out
}))
# --- Optional: classification taken from the metadata of the TIL object ---
if (classification == "metadata") {
  stopifnot(!is.null(metadata_class_column), metadata_class_column %in% colnames(md))
  key <- paste(md$patient_id, md$cdr3_j)
  classes <- tapply(as.character(md[[metadata_class_column]]), key, function(x) names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1])
  clonotypes$class_pe_vs_bulk <- clonotypes$class
  clonotypes$class <- unname(classes[paste(clonotypes$patient, clonotypes$cdr3_j)])
  class_levels <- unique(c(class_levels, stats::na.omit(clonotypes$class)))
}
clonotypes$log2_PE_vs_Bulk <- ifelse(clonotypes$PE_freq > 0 & clonotypes$Bulk_freq > 0,
                                     round(log2(clonotypes$PE_freq / clonotypes$Bulk_freq), 2), NA_real_)
clonotypes$class <- factor(clonotypes$class, levels = class_levels)
# --- Summary per patient: clonotypes and cells of the cluster in each class ---
summary_clonotypes <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(clonotypes$patient, clonotypes$class))
summary_cells <- as.data.frame.matrix(xtabs(cells_in_cluster ~ patient + class, clonotypes))
cat("Clonotypes per class:\n")
print(cbind(summary_clonotypes, Total = rowSums(summary_clonotypes)))
cat("Cells of the cluster per class:\n")
print(cbind(summary_cells, Total = rowSums(summary_cells)))
```

# deg / dep

Cells of the cluster, grouped by the class of their clonotype. Two comparisons:

- **strict**: Expanded vs Not expanded.
- **broad**: Expanded vs Not expanded + Not detected in PE or Bulk (every classified clonotype that does not expand).

Each comparison is run on the cells of all the patients together and on each patient separately (when it has
at least `min_cells_single` cells in both groups). Wilcoxon rank-sum test (Seurat `FindMarkers`): RNA on log-normalized
counts, without TCR, mitochondrial and ribosomal genes; protein on the normalized ADT values, without isotype
controls. Because the patients contribute differently to each group, every feature also gets the number of
patients (with at least `min_cells_patient` cells in both groups) in which the difference goes in the same
direction as in the pooled test.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
cell_class <- clonotypes$class[match(paste(md$patient_id, md$cdr3_j), paste(clonotypes$patient, clonotypes$cdr3_j))]
cell_class[!in_cluster] <- NA
sub <- subset(obj, cells = rownames(md)[!is.na(cell_class)])
sub$expansion_class <- as.character(cell_class[!is.na(cell_class)])
rm(obj)
invisible(gc())
DefaultAssay(sub) <- "RNA"
sub <- NormalizeData(sub, verbose = FALSE)
exclude_pattern <- "^(TR[ABDG][VJCD]|MT-|RPL|MRPL|MRPS|RPS(?!6K))"
genes_keep <- rownames(sub[["RNA"]])[!grepl(exclude_pattern, rownames(sub[["RNA"]]), perl = TRUE)]
proteins_keep <- rownames(sub[["ADT"]])[!grepl("isotype", rownames(sub[["ADT"]]), ignore.case = TRUE)]
comparisons <- list(
  strict = list(group_1 = "Expanded", group_2 = "Not expanded"),
  broad = list(group_1 = "Expanded", group_2 = c("Not expanded", "Not detected in PE or Bulk"))
)
compare <- function(assay, features, comparison, min.pct, patient = NULL) {
  in_scope <- if (is.null(patient)) rep(TRUE, ncol(sub)) else sub$patient_id == patient
  cells_1 <- colnames(sub)[in_scope & sub$expansion_class %in% comparison$group_1]
  cells_2 <- colnames(sub)[in_scope & sub$expansion_class %in% comparison$group_2]
  if (min(length(cells_1), length(cells_2)) < (if (is.null(patient)) min_cells_pooled else min_cells_single)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  res <- FindMarkers(sub, ident.1 = cells_1, ident.2 = cells_2, assay = assay, features = features,
                     test.use = "wilcox", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = min.pct, verbose = FALSE)
  data <- LayerData(sub, assay = assay, layer = "data")[rownames(res), , drop = FALSE]
  res$feature <- rownames(res)
  res$mean_1 <- Matrix::rowMeans(data[, cells_1, drop = FALSE])
  res$mean_2 <- Matrix::rowMeans(data[, cells_2, drop = FALSE])
  res$difference <- res$mean_1 - res$mean_2
  # --- Direction of the difference within each patient ---
  tested <- same <- integer(nrow(res))
  for (one in unique(sub$patient_id)) {
    p1 <- cells_1[sub$patient_id[match(cells_1, colnames(sub))] == one]
    p2 <- cells_2[sub$patient_id[match(cells_2, colnames(sub))] == one]
    if (length(p1) >= min_cells_patient && length(p2) >= min_cells_patient) {
      d <- Matrix::rowMeans(data[, p1, drop = FALSE]) - Matrix::rowMeans(data[, p2, drop = FALSE])
      tested <- tested + 1L
      same <- same + as.integer(sign(d) == sign(res$difference) & d != 0)
    }
  }
  res$patients_tested <- tested
  res$patients_same_direction <- same
  res$cells_1 <- length(cells_1)
  res$cells_2 <- length(cells_2)
  fc_column <- grep("^avg_", colnames(res), value = TRUE)[1]
  res$effect <- res[[fc_column]]
  res$effect_name <- fc_column
  res[order(res$p_val), c("feature", "effect", "effect_name", "difference", "mean_1", "mean_2", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val", "p_val_adj",
                          "patients_same_direction", "patients_tested", "cells_1", "cells_2")]
}
# --- Results are named "<DEG|DEP>_<comparison>|<all or patient>" ---
results <- list()
for (name in names(comparisons)) {
  for (scope in c("all", patients_use)) {
    patient <- if (scope == "all") NULL else scope
    results[paste0("DEG_", name, "|", scope)] <- list(compare("RNA", genes_keep, comparisons[[name]], min.pct = 0.1, patient = patient))
    results[paste0("DEP_", name, "|", scope)] <- list(compare("ADT", proteins_keep, comparisons[[name]], min.pct = 0, patient = patient))
  }
}
results_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results), function(name) {
  res <- results[[name]]
  data.frame(
    result = name,
    cells_1 = if (is.null(res)) NA else res$cells_1[1],
    cells_2 = if (is.null(res)) NA else res$cells_2[1],
    tested = if (is.null(res)) NA else nrow(res),
    higher_in_expanded = if (is.null(res)) NA else sum(res$p_val_adj < padj_cutoff & res$difference > 0),
    lower_in_expanded = if (is.null(res)) NA else sum(res$p_val_adj < padj_cutoff & res$difference < 0)
  )
}))
print(results_summary, row.names = FALSE)
for (name in grep("\\|all$", names(results), value = TRUE)) {
  if (is.null(results[[name]])) next
  cat("\n", name, "\n")
  print(head(results[[name]][, c("feature", "effect", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val_adj", "patients_same_direction", "patients_tested")], 12), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# save

```{r}
write_tsv <- function(x, file) write.table(x, file.path(output_dir, file), sep = "\t", dec = ",", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write_tsv(clonotypes[order(clonotypes$patient, clonotypes$class, -clonotypes$cells_in_cluster), ], "CD4_CXCL13_clonotypes.tsv")
write_tsv(cbind(patient = rownames(summary_clonotypes), summary_clonotypes), "CD4_CXCL13_clonotypes_per_class.tsv")
write_tsv(cbind(patient = rownames(summary_cells), summary_cells), "CD4_CXCL13_cells_per_class.tsv")
for (name in names(results)) {
  if (!is.null(results[[name]])) write_tsv(results[[name]], paste0("CD4_CXCL13_", sub("\\|all$", "", sub("\\|(CHUM_.*)$", "_\\1", name)), ".tsv"))
}
write_tsv(results_summary, "CD4_CXCL13_DEG_DEP_summary.tsv")
list.files(output_dir)
```

# html

Interactive report: the data are embedded as JSON in `scripts/reports/cxcl13-expansion-template.html`.

```{r}
if (file.exists(template_file)) {
  quantize <- function(v) {
    rng <- range(v)
    as.integer(round((v - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1]) * coord_quant))
  }
  class_all <- match(as.character(cell_class), class_levels) - 1L
  class_all[is.na(class_all)] <- -1L
  report <- list(
    generated = format(Sys.Date()),
    cluster = cluster_name,
    classification = if (classification == "metadata") paste0("metadata column ", metadata_class_column) else "PE vs Bulk (TCRb-seq)",
    classes = I(class_levels),
    quant = coord_quant,
    padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff,
    patients = I(sort(unique(md$patient_id))),
    umap = list(
      x = quantize(emb[, 1]),
      y = quantize(emb[, 2]),
      patient = match(md$patient_id, sort(unique(md$patient_id))) - 1L,
      in_cluster = as.integer(in_cluster),
      class = class_all
    ),
    clonotypes = list(
      columns = I(colnames(clonotypes)),
      rows = lapply(seq_len(nrow(clonotypes)), function(i) {
        lapply(clonotypes[i, ], function(v) if (is.factor(v)) as.character(v) else if (is.numeric(v) && !is.na(v)) signif(v, 4) else v)
      })
    ),
    comparisons = lapply(comparisons, function(x) list(group_1 = paste(x$group_1, collapse = " + "), group_2 = paste(x$group_2, collapse = " + "))),
    results = lapply(results, function(res) {
      if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
      list(
        effect_name = res$effect_name[1], cells_1 = res$cells_1[1], cells_2 = res$cells_2[1],
        feature = res$feature, effect = round(res$effect, 3), difference = signif(res$difference, 3),
        pct_1 = res$pct.1, pct_2 = res$pct.2, p = signif(res$p_val, 3), padj = signif(res$p_val_adj, 3),
        same = res$patients_same_direction, tested = res$patients_tested
      )
    })
  )
  json <- gsub("</", "<\\/", jsonlite::toJSON(report, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", digits = NA, null = "null"), fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(paste(readLines(template_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n"), "/*__DATA__*/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  stopifnot(length(parts) == 2)
  output_file <- file.path(output_dir, "CD4_CXCL13_expansion_report.html")
  con <- file(output_file, open = "wb")
  writeLines(c(parts[1], json, parts[2]), con, sep = "", useBytes = TRUE)
  close(con)
  cat("Written:", output_file, "(", round(file.size(output_file) / 1024^2, 1), "MB )\n")
} else {
  message("Template not found, HTML report skipped: ", template_file)
}
```
